entities.summary: Stian Arnesen (b. 1978-05-07, Hamar Municipality) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Hamar Municipality and Norway. Known in the fields of norway, composers & musicians, europe.
